therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with heart failure and control subjects without cardiovascular disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Relationship between adverse cardiac events and 123I-mIBG uptake categorized as high or low heart-to-mediastinum (H/M) ratio at approximately 24 months

results.target_engagement_evidence: H/M ratio ≥1.6 vs <1.6 at 3 hours 50 minutes post-administration of 123I-mIBG, assessed by 3 independent readers
biomarker_changes: H/M ratio categorized as High (≥1.6) or Low (<1.6) based on planar scintigraphy at ~4 hours post-injection
High H/M ratio group: 14 adverse cardiac events; Low H/M ratio group: 100 adverse cardiac events (consistent across all 3 readers)
safety_signals: 1 death reported in the AdreView Heart Failure Group (1/532)

context.duration: Approximately 24 months from date of 123I-mIBG administration

results_by_chain.endpoint: Time to adverse cardiac event (H/M ratio high vs low)
results_by_chain.mechanism_description: sympathetic nerve terminal uptake and retention imaging
results_by_chain.population_description: heart failure patients assessed by Reader A, stratified by H/M ratio ≥1.6 (high) vs <1.6 (low)
